purpose: one-time synthetic FD confirmation of frozen 25-event source-conditioned 5 Hz PINN
data: original Overthrust 401x401x94, grid spacing 40 m, 25 existing receivers, dt 0.002 s, 0--2 s, 5 Hz FD, six zero-Dirichlet faces

inverse.misfit_scale: full unstrided observation RMS fixed across all candidates
inverse.start_selection: three lowest coarse losses on registered grid; deterministic tie break by candidate ordering
inverse.source_truth_use: post-inversion error computation only; no truth-centred bounds, initial guesses or candidate insertion

guardrails: Frozen checkpoint, no new tuning, no gain/time shift fitting, no resampling of events after inspecting results. Report every event, per-event source and origin-time error, truth-source misfit, model parameter limits, FD runtimes. The 8 events are synthetic one-time confirmation after extensive same-model development, not field validation or multi-seed coverage. Any later adjustments consume this set as development data.
